title: Exterior presheaf under open pullback
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module M, a natural number n and an open U, the presheaf pullback along U.ι of the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf is isomorphic to the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf of M.restrict U.ι.

proof.text: Apply exteriorPresheaf_open_pullback_data to obtain component isomorphisms and their naturality, then assemble them using PresheafOfModules.isoMk. The upstream theorem is already fully proved; the old exteriorSheafPresheaf API is compared with PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower privately in the consumer by uniqueness of restrictions on pure wedges.

proof_origin.note: Retirement adaptation: use the proved upstream presheaf theorem, moving the existing private equality bridge to the sole consumer without changing its public signature. The unit route and mathematical statements are preserved.

theorem exteriorPresheaf_open_pullback {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) :
    Nonempty ((PresheafOfModules.pullback.{v} U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom.hom).obj
      (_root_.PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (R := _) M.val n) ≅
        _root_.PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (R := _) (M.restrict U.ι).val n)
